author: 1kwjpo
quote:
Gta in name only. 
Restrictive, slow, dull, they added a bunch of pointless romance and chore stuff to create controversy because they knew who they would upset, and that people upset at Rockstar abandoning the essence of gta and be mostly unable to point out what is wrong with out sounding insane. 

They just wanted to paint at target on so they could say "look at the incel conservatives they hate women, chores and doing the right thing" 

It shouldn't take 6-10 hours to progressively gain access to stealing better cars, let alone "get good" its supposed to be a sandbox game not an immersive Sim, and if it is supposed to be an "immersive sim" it pails in comparison of player agency to the greats. 

An immersive sim that limits your choice on the core mechanism of the game "the relationship" to a binary is not an immersive sim at all.

There's too much wrong with the game as a gta game to even touch on in one review.

Notice the perfect split in the reviews and how artificial the 10/10 reviews sound BTW.
